To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
new xanthen-4-one-9-acetic acid analogues were synthesized, and some of them were more active than the parent compound DMXAA on both murine macrophenic and human monocytes.

new XAA derivatives are able to stimulate macrophages and monocytes to become tumoricidally active and that some of these compounds are more active than DMXA, the most potent XAA analog synthesized so far.
new compounds with a cyclic structure in positions 5,6 of xanthenone-9-one- 4-acetic acid have been synthesized.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new class of antitumor agents, which are able to induce macrophages and monocytes to become tumoricidals.
the design and synthesis of a new series of xanthenone derivatives, which have shown promising results in terms of both their direct and their indirect antitumor activity.
the synthesis of a new series of XAA analogues, which have been shown to be more active than the parent compound XAN and DMXAA in inducing macrophage and monocyte cytotoxicity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
compounds 4a and 5a, as well as the most active compounds 7a, and 13a,b are promising new leads for further investigation.

the presence of a cyclic structure in positions 5-6 of XAA analogues does not affect the ability of these compounds to induce TNF secretion in monocytes and to stimulate macrophages to become tumoricidals.
the presence of cyclic substituents in XAA derivatives can improve their activity as macrophage activators, especially in the case of human monocytes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the introduction of the 1,4-dioxane ring in the 5- or 6-position of XAA leads to compounds endowed with a significant antitumor activity.
compounds 7a, DMXAA, 13a and 16a are the most promising compounds for the development of antitumoral drugs.
the introduction of a cyclic moiety in the 5,6-positions of XAA is able to improve its biological properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the introduction of a 2,3-disubstituted pyrrolidine moiety in position 5 of the xanthen- 9-one ring of XAA leads to the synthesis of a series of new compounds that are able to enhance the tumoricidal activity of murine and human immune cells.
the presence of a 2-phenyl group on the pyridine moiety is essential to the antitumor activity.
the synthesis of XAA analogues with a cyclic structure in positions 5 or 6 of the xanthen-1-one nucleus is a valid strategy to obtain compounds with a higher antitumor activity.
